title: 06/30/2023 - Software Updates
content:
## 06/30/2023 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000094659

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We updated member search results pages to always display the "Closest to Location" option in the sort order dropdown when the type of location that was searched for is set to be a "Radius" search in the Advanced Settings of the site. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Results - Sorting Options Search - Member - Search Query

- We updated the Bulk Geocoder in the Admin in order to update the filename of the geocoded member's profile page automatically.

- The "Items Selected" text when selecting multiple categories on Post Type search modules is now a Text Label. Text Label Involved: items_selected

- We added 5 more custom content sections to the homepage content to display. To use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Select Content to Display.

- We added a tooltip message to the "Email Admin" column header on the Billing Email Settings page in the Admin to explain how that option works.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Profile Completeness Progress Bar in the Member Dashboard from working properly in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Search Members page in the Admin from returning accurate results when searching based on Member Categories with the "Complete Profiles" filter active in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Back To Previous Page" button for the Members Only Content Add-On from working properly in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Members Only Message

- We created a new Design Setting called "Mobile Hero Image". This setting allows Admins to set a separate hero image on the homepage to be used when the site is loaded on mobile devices. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD Bootstrap Theme - Homepage

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the horizontal view of the "Sub + Sub-Sub Homepage Category Search" homepage search from aligning the elements properly in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Sub + Sub-Sub

- We fixed an issue with the Code Editor when editing the HTACCESS File from the Admin which was causing the system to transform content next to "&" symbols after saving in some cases.

- We implemented an update to the "Sub Sub-Sub" and "Sub Sub-Sub + Location" Dynamic Category search widgets so that when visiting the search results page for a Top Category on a site, only the sub and sub-sub categories related to that Top Category will display in the Dynamic Category search widget.

- We added the "Standard Theme" as an option available on the Change Homepage Theme section when visiting the Design Settings page in the Admin.  This is the same theme that new websites launch with.

- The title of Digital Product posts is now available as an Email Variable called "group_name". Email Variable Involved: group_name

- We updated the logic of member category dropdowns in the "Website - Lead Form - Get Matched" form when shown on member profile pages to hide the category dropdowns if the member has not selected that type of category.  For example, if a member has not selected any Sub Categories, the Sub Categories dropdown will not display in the Get Matched form displayed on their profile page. Widget Involved: Bootstrap - Contact Member Category Dropdowns

- We updated the way some content loads in the <HEAD> of member profile pages to improve loading speed and page performance. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD

- We updated the display of member profile badge images in order to set "width" and "height" attributes for each image. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Badges

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Top Categories Recent Homepage widget when the Text Direction Advanced Setting was set to "Right to Left" in some cases.

- We updated the workflow of manually matching leads to members to display a notification modal when an Admin is trying to manually set a member as a "Pending" match to a lead which has already been accepted / purchased the maximum number of times as set in the Lead Settings.

- We fixed an issue with the Insta-Load Search Results Add-On which was preventing the system from loading more results on post search result pages in some cases.

- We implemented an update to the Claimable Business Listing Add-On in order to reference the previous member email when logging that the member was claimed in the Activity Tracker.
